import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int src, dst;
        long cap, cost;
        Edge rev;

        Edge(int src, int dst, long cap, long cost, Edge rev) {
            this.src = src;
            this.dst = dst;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.cost = cost;
            this.rev = rev;
        }
    }

    static class FlowBase {
        List<List<Edge>> adj;

        FlowBase(int n) {
            adj = new ArrayList<>(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
        }

        FlowBase(FlowBase other) {
            adj = new ArrayList<>(other.adj.size());
            for (int i = 0; i < other.adj.size(); i++) {
                adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            for (int node = 0; node < other.adj.size(); node++) {
                for (Edge e : other.adj.get(node)) {
                    if (e.src == node) {
                        Edge newEdge = new Edge(e.src, e.dst, e.cap, e.cost, null);
                        Edge newRev = new Edge(e.dst, e.src, e.rev.cap, e.rev.cost, null);
                        newEdge.rev = newRev;
                        newRev.rev = newEdge;
                        adj.get(e.src).add(newEdge);
                        adj.get(e.dst).add(newRev);
                    } else {
                        e.rev.rev.src = node;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int size() {
            return adj.size();
        }

        List<Edge> get(int node) {
            return adj.get(node);
        }

        void addEdge(int src, int dst, long cap, long cost) {
            if (cap <= 0) return;
            Edge forward = new Edge(src, dst, cap, cost, null);
            Edge backward = new Edge(dst, src, 0, -cost, null);
            forward.rev = backward;
            backward.rev = forward;
            adj.get(src).add(forward);
            adj.get(dst).add(backward);
        }
    }

    static class MinCostFlow extends FlowBase {
        long minCost, totalCost;
        long[] supp;
        long[] ptnl;

        MinCostFlow(int n) {
            super(n);
            minCost = 0;
            totalCost = 0;
            supp = new long[n];
            ptnl = new long[n];
        }

        MinCostFlow(MinCostFlow other) {
            super(other);
            minCost = other.minCost;
            totalCost = other.totalCost;
            supp = Arrays.copyOf(other.supp, other.supp.length);
            ptnl = Arrays.copyOf(other.ptnl, other.ptnl.length);
        }

        void addEdge(int src, int dst, long cap, long cost) {
            if (cap <= 0) return;
            if (cost < 0) {
                supp[src] -= cap;
                supp[dst] += cap;
                minCost += cap * cost;
                totalCost -= cap * cost;
                super.addEdge(dst, src, cap, -cost);
            } else {
                totalCost += cap * cost;
                super.addEdge(src, dst, cap, cost);
            }
        }

        void supply(int node, long vol) {
            supp[node] += vol;
        }

        boolean flow() {
            for (boolean aug = true; aug; ) {
                aug = false;
                Edge[] last = new Edge[size()];
                dijkstra(last);
                boolean[] shut = new boolean[size()];
                for (int dst = 0; dst < size(); dst++) {
                    if (supp[dst] < 0 && last[dst] != null) {
                        long resid = -supp[dst];
                        int src = dst;
                        int block = -1;
                        while (last[src] != null && !shut[src]) {
                            if (resid >= last[src].cap) {
                                resid = last[src].cap;
                                block = src;
                            }
                            src = last[src].src;
                        }
                        if (shut[src]) {
                            block = src;
                        } else {
                            if (resid >= supp[src]) {
                                resid = supp[src];
                                block = src;
                            }
                            for (int node = dst; node != src; node = last[node].src) {
                                last[node].cap -= resid;
                                last[node].rev.cap += resid;
                            }
                            supp[src] -= resid;
                            supp[dst] += resid;
                            minCost += ptnl[dst] * resid;
                            aug = true;
                        }
                        if (block != -1) {
                            for (int node = dst; node != block; node = last[node].src) {
                                shut[node] = true;
                            }
                            shut[block] = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            for (long s : supp) {
                if (s > 0) return false;
            }
            return true;
        }

        void dijkstra(Edge[] last) {
            long infty = totalCost + 1;
            long[] dist = new long[size()];
            Arrays.fill(dist, infty);
            PriorityQueue<long[]> que = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingLong(a -> -a[0]));
            for (int node = 0; node < size(); node++) {
                if (supp[node] > 0) {
                    dist[node] = 0;
                    que.offer(new long[]{0, node});
                }
            }
            while (!que.isEmpty()) {
                long[] top = que.poll();
                long nsp = top[0];
                int node = (int) top[1];
                if (-nsp != dist[node]) continue;
                ptnl[node] -= nsp;
                if (ptnl[node] > infty) ptnl[node] = infty;
                dist[node] = -1;
                for (Edge e : adj.get(node)) {
                    if (dist[e.dst] == -1 || e.cap == 0) continue;
                    if (dist[e.dst] + ptnl[e.dst] > ptnl[node] + e.cost) {
                        dist[e.dst] = ptnl[node] + e.cost - ptnl[e.dst];
                        last[e.dst] = e;
                        que.offer(new long[]{-dist[e.dst], e.dst});
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        long optimal() {
            assert flow();
            return minCost;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        
        MinCostFlow mcf = new MinCostFlow(6100);
        final int tlim = 105;
        
        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int j = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            mcf.supply(j, 1);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int u = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            int v = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            for (int t = 0; t < tlim; t++) {
                int nu = u + n;
                int nv = v + n;
                for (int x = 0; x < k; x++) {
                    mcf.addEdge(u, nv, 1, c + d * (x * 2 + 1));
                    mcf.addEdge(v, nu, 1, c + d * (x * 2 + 1));
                }
                u = nu;
                v = nv;
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int t = 0; t < tlim; t++) {
                mcf.addEdge(n * t + i, n * (t + 1) + i, k, c);
            }
        }
        
        int dst = mcf.size() - 1;
        mcf.supply(dst, -k);
        for (int t = 0; t <= tlim; t++) {
            mcf.addEdge(t * n, dst, k, 0);
        }
        
        System.out.println(mcf.optimal());
    }
}
